title: security: RBAC v2 - KMS region-pinning audit enhancements + optional residency allowlist
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: tighten telemetry and enforcement around KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies and provide an operator-facing allowlist for explicit data residency needs. This PR extends audit logging for RBAC v2 KMS operations, adds an optional 'residency_allowlist' that lets tenant admins declare allowed regions for KMS-backed secrets, and wires a feature-flagged enforcement path. Changes are designed for backwards compatibility: audit-only by default, with a clear rollout plan to flip enforcement after validation. Includes schema additions, migration backfill, API surface, audit event enrichment, operator tooling, dashboards, and tests. Rollout plan: enable audit flag in staging for 72h, review violations, update allowlist, enable enforcement for non-critical tenants, gradual wider rollout. Related: Linear ENG-2345, SEC-112; Jira SUP-901.
commits: feat(rbac): add kms_region and kms_key_alias to policy + audit events
chore(migrations): backfill kms_region for 30d of audit events
feat(flags): add rbac_v2_kms_pin_audit and rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce feature flags
test: unit + integration for residency allowlist and enforcement path
docs: runbook and rollout notes for ops
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can you confirm the migration is reversible? We should avoid long locks during the backfill.
Priya Nair: Migration is additive and uses chunked reads/writes; no schema down migration needed. Added script and operator docs explaining rollback is removing flags and allowlist changes.
María López: We need more visibility into which tenants would be blocked if enforcement flips on; added dashboard and alert rule (audit-only violations > 100/day).
Samir Patel: Minor nit on API naming, prefer PATCH /tenancies/{id}/residency instead of residency_allowlist; accepted and added alias for backwards compatibility.
release_notes: Add audit enrichment for KMS region pinning and optional tenancy residency_allowlist. Introduces feature flags rbac_v2_kms_pin_audit (audit-only) and rbac_v2_kms_pin_enforce (enforcement path). Includes migration to backfill recent KMS region info and operator dashboards/alerts.
